763|id.rationale: The caller shows a Shares table of collection share records with audience and permissions. “Berbagi koleksi” alone can describe the act of sharing a collection; adding “Daftar” makes clear that the share list is unavailable.

772|zh-Hans.rationale: The JSX immediately appends the count and an ASCII closing parenthesis. Keep the ASCII opening delimiter and the source space before it, but remove the proposed extra space after “(” so the rendered count is not separated from its opening delimiter.
